answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can price admission with a bonded attestation ladder: every new agent pays a per-identity proof-of-work and stakes a refundable bond, and each existing voucher must lock its own unlocked balance behind that newcomer. A later audit slashes a false voucher, so a farm of N clones owes N mining bills plus N bonds, and one dishonest voucher burns its earned standing. An ember of faked identity cannot ignite a vine of clones without paying the gale price of real, slashable capital, so attacker scale becomes attacker loss before any epoch reward is reachable.
